reviews.title: Worked great, until recent.
reviews.text:
I’ve been a paid user of AVG for a couple years now, and I’ve had no problems. It used to work. The newest update however has caused me problems to where I’m considering canceling my subscription and seeking out a competitor. 

The VPN no longer works, it can’t connect to any one server. I get error pop ups saying “VPN Connection Error”. I changed nothing in my settings, nor is the internet down on my end, so this must be an issue with AVG itself. 

I attempted customer support but that’s been replaced with AI assistant, so that’s useless. Without any apparent solution, unless there’s a fix I’m unaware of, I’ll have to cancel.

reviews.title: FRAUD & Apple Support
reviews.text:
I downloaded this app because of the 7 day free trial. It provided the plan pricing for one year but, when I clicked out of the app, a lower price popped up, so I accepted the lower price.

I though once my free trial was up, I could decide at that time if I wanted to cancel or keep the product. 

WRONG!!!!!

I was charged for the entire year without the free trial. And when I submitted a refund through apple support, my refund was denied because they stated my charge was valid. 

Now I’m LIVID!!!!

Apple referred me to the sellers and Guess What!  Guess who they do not provide refunds to, you guessed it, Anyone who purchases this software through 3rd party vendors including the App Store. 

So now I have to dispute this through my bank and file a complaint. 

I will never purchase another item on the app store until this is resolved.  I should have listened to the reviews, I should’ve listened.

reviews.title: Be careful
reviews.text:
I have spent a lot of time over the last year and a half trying to cancel all my AVG subscriptions. I believe I could write a small book from the experience and have ended up with a strong dislike of the product and the company’s policies. 

I have followed the proscribed procedure several times and am still being billed for software that I do not like or want. One experience involved being connected through their “software support” system to a couple of people who described software they needed to use to remove their programs but I am quite sure they were up to no good. I ended up cutting them off and not long after had my SSD drive fill and crash. Several times. 

Be careful with these people. There are other options.
